Name: Emmrich Volkarin (Rasmodius Wizard Replacement)
Author: Akatra
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/FHKSp5Ty/emmrich.png[/img]﻿
This mod replaces the Wizard's portraits and character sprites with Emmrich Volkarin from Dragon Age: The Veilguard.
If you'd like, you can also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30760]adopt Manfred[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿, a mod I worked on alongside this one![/center]﻿﻿﻿﻿[b]Requirements:

[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url][left][/left][b]
Installation:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI (For those who have never modded SDV, here is a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkohJW_TFRg]guide[/url]﻿)
[*]Follow the installation instructions for the mod you want to use this replacer with (whether it's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]RomRasSVE[/url]﻿, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]﻿)
[*]If it hasn't already been installed as part of those mod's instructions, proceed to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].﻿
[*]Download my mod and extract it into your mods folder.
[*]For this mod to work as intended, you will have to change the portraits and sprites by accessing generic mod config menu.
It's at the bottom of Stardew Valley's parameters. By default, it'll use the Stardew Valley expanded portraits.
[*][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Y0mb4xkG/Portraits.jpg[/img]﻿
[*]In this window, you'll have to pick the portrait amount and sprite type compatible with your romance mod.

[/list]If you're having trouble installing these mods or are new to modding, I've created a little [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1IcXvmSu8SVFhcN-JItzibOrp5QECW0mSt57EM1DzeZg/edit?usp=sharing]spreadsheet [/url]﻿to help you track which mods you've installed, depending on the romance mod you want to play. Just download the document and use it however you like!
[b]
Compatiblity:[/b]

[b]7 portraits[/b] and [b]SVE [/b]sprite for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[b]9 portraits[/b] and [b]RomRas [/b]sprite for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]
[b]12 portraits[/b] and [b]RomRas [/b]sprite for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius - SVE Compatible[/url]
[b]32 portraits[/b] and [b]RRRR [/b]sprite for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped
[center][/center][/url][b]
Notes:
[/b]
This is my very first mod, and while I’ve tested it, it’s probably not perfect (at all). If you run into any bugs or issues, let me know! I’ll do my best to fix anything that comes up. I'll eventually come up with seasonal outfits for Emmrich, but I'm still wrapping my head around it. I'm also working on a way to change the Wizard's name, for accuracy and immersion! I’d like to point out that I wouldn’t have been able to do this without [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Jellonip]Jellonip[/url]’s amazing guide and my friend’s support. (Thank you so much, Porg, for helping little me understand how all of this works.)

Replaced the Wizard's painting with one of Emmrich, along with the Junimo bundle.
